notes.title: Some major breakthroughs and updates!
notes.content:
[h2]Well hello, boys! Good to see you again.[/h2]
I'll keep this pretty short. There's been some major breakthroughs, so the full game will have support for the following platforms:
[list]
[*] PC
[*] PS4/5
[*] Xbox One/S/X
[*] Steamdeck
[*] Switch
[*] VR
[/list]
Also, full controller support has been added (or rather, readded, since there has been before, but was kinda shit), ability to utilise either DLSS or FSR, depending on your graphics card, a menu system that's a lot more comprehensive and in-depth, allowing you to customize pretty much everything to your liking.
There's also been A LOT of work done on optimization, so my measly 3070 runs the game in 4k, Ultra settings, with around 25-30 fps, which is pretty damn awesome, considering I wasn't testing on a packaged game, but rather the standalone game mode, with the project still open.
Also, two new, large hospital and subway maps have been added and 2 new monster types.

[h1]Check out the new screenshots![/h1]
Hearing your guys' complaints about asset flipping, I've bought a new subway train asset, to change the old, free one. You were right, it's kinda cringe using the same asset over and over, even though it's pretty damn good looking. But we have a new one, the London Tube Train, which looks pretty good imo.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949613/96fdcdee209ee4e978a90c8b7bfe5505da264eb1.png[/img]\

Oh and I almost forgot about this, but... I've bought some packs with photoscanned maps, that will be used for multiplayer. So kinda like CS2, but bodycam style. This is come after the release of the story mode, though. But still, it's gonna be awesome.

So yeah, anyway, I said I'll keep this short but I plonked yet another wall of text hah.
[h3]God bless each and everyone of you gorgeous and awesome bastards, I love you![/h3]

notes.title: Some bad news and some good news.
notes.content:
[b][h3]Well hello hello! How are ya?[/h3]
I'm just gonna rip the bandaid off and start with the bad news first. [i]The game is gonna be delayed[/i]... 
I thought I'd be able to finish in time for the Steam halloween event, but nope! I tried but the scope and scale of the project has increased significantly, so yeah..

I'm really sorry to all of you guys waiting, but I thought about it and I'd rather delay the game than release some rushed, unfinished and unpolished piece of shit game. So I'm gonna take my time and do things properly.

On the good news side, we've got a new and extremely more realistic map and the game went from 1h to 2,5h+ (probably more to be honest, not sure yet). I've been working a lot on improving the atmosphere, animations, soundscapes, visuals etc. It's been a long road but.. God willing, it's close to the end.

Now we have extensive gun play, with ammo management and gun attachments that you need to find or unlock (don't worry, none of that microtransaction shit), like 10 types of (pretty cool) monsters, a periodical save system (by periodical I mean you can't save when you want, it's at certain points in the game, kind of like checkpoints), health management and pickups and much more. I'm really excited about what this game has become and where it's headed!
[h3]You can think of the game as if PT and Cry of Fear had a child, and that child had mental issues.[/h3]
I'll be posting clips this week with some of these elements, which I hope you guys find as exciting as I do.
So.. yeah. That's pretty much it. I hope you're prepared to spend like 2-3 hours in this world, it's gonna be a wild ride. 

Thank you guys so much for the incredible support and amazing comments and feedback, you have no idea how much you've helped.
Love all you guys and God bless you!
See you soon.[/b]
